independent_recount.how: A second script, written separately and run under WSL python3, matched the raw Limitless set and number strings (B1/184, P-B/11, P-B/54) in each development-half list's Pokemon section, grouping by exact deck.name containing 'Altaria'. It shares no code with the main scan.
independent_recount.espeon_noncarrier: the same single list (2 Eevee B4 131, Tail Rap, no Boosted Evolution)
independent_recount.cross_check_with_kt_census: list and event counts per Altaria archetype equal the kt carrier census's (census_summary.json: Espeon 336/52, Greninja 125/42, bare 44/28, Chingling 38/17, Igglybuff 25/20)

script: limitless_carriers.py and the recount were run from the session scratchpad, not added to the repo (this folder's brief allowed only the .md, the .json and edits to REGISTRATION_DRAFT.md); the method is in limitless_carriers.md section 1 and reproduces from the Cowork pull alone.

verifier_recount.how: A third script, written without reading limitless_carriers.py or the recount, opened only the 63 development standings and details files (event ids from split.json). It found the flag printings by searching lib/deckgym-database.json for the Ability text the mechanic map sends to CanEvolveOnFirstTurnIfActive, and got B1 184, P-B 011, P-B 054.
verifier_recount.named_lists: the same Espeon non-carrier (therico01, 2 Eevee B4 131) and the same four Igglybuff carriers (leonemesis 9th of 24; pamnardo_s2 63rd of 81 and 67th of 69; fluffy_panda1995 61st of 112)
verifier_recount.top30: carrier archetypes in the Sept 10 top 30: Mega Altaria ex Espeon, Mega Altaria ex Igglybuff; in the window top 30: Mega Altaria ex Espeon only (kt census census_summary.json)
